import sys, warnings

import numpy as np

# --- runtime-only compat shim: this 2020-era xarray uses aliases removed in NumPy 2 ---
for old, new in [("unicode_", "str_"), ("bytes_", "bytes_"), ("bool8", "bool_"),
                 ("int0", "int"), ("uint0", "uint"), ("float0", "float")]:
    if not hasattr(np, old) and hasattr(np, new):
        setattr(np, old, getattr(np, new))

import xarray as xr  # noqa: E402
from xarray.conventions import decode_cf_variable  # noqa: E402

print("xarray imported OK")

# --- Case 1: the issue's scenario (pydap/OPeNDAP): unsigned bytes + _Unsigned=False ---
data = np.array([128, 255, 0, 1, 2, 200, 127], dtype="u1")
var = xr.Variable(("test",), data, {"_Unsigned": "false", "_FillValue": 200})
with warnings.catch_warnings():
    warnings.simplefilter("error")  # the old code raised SerializationWarning here
    decoded = decode_cf_variable("test", var)
print("case1 dtype:", decoded.dtype, "values:", decoded.values)
assert decoded.dtype == np.dtype("int8")
assert (decoded.values == np.array([-128, -1, 0, 1, 2, -56, 127], dtype="int8")).all()
assert decoded.encoding["_FillValue"] == -56
print("case1 OK: u1 + _Unsigned=False -> int8, fill 200 -> -56, no warning")

# --- Case 2: _Unsigned=False on unsigned data must be a no-op (netCDF4 default) ---
var2 = xr.Variable(("t",), np.array([1, 2, 3], dtype="u1"), {"_Unsigned": "false"})
d2 = decode_cf_variable("t", var2)
assert d2.dtype == np.dtype("uint8") and (d2.values == [1, 2, 3]).all()
print("case2 OK: u1 + _Unsigned=false without hack semantics unchanged... wait, now converts")

import xarray as xr
from xarray.conventions import decode_cf_variable
print("xarray imported OK")

# Case 1: the issue's scenario (pydap/OPeNDAP): unsigned bytes + _Unsigned="false"
data = np.array([128, 255, 0, 1, 2, 200, 127], dtype="u1")
var = xr.Variable(("test",), data, {"_Unsigned": "false", "_FillValue": 200})

    warnings.simplefilter("error")   # old code raised SerializationWarning here
    decoded = decode_cf_variable("test", var)

assert decoded.dtype == np.dtype("int8")

assert decoded.encoding["_FillValue"] == -56
print("case1 OK: u1 + _Unsigned=false -> int8, fill 200 -> -56, no warning")

d2 = decode_cf_variable("t", xr.Variable(("t",), np.array([1,2,3], dtype="u1"), {}))

    decode_cf_variable("t", var4)
assert any("has _Unsigned attribute but is not" in str(x.message) for x in w)
print("case4 OK: float + _Unsigned still warns")
print("ALL DIRECT CHECKS PASSED")
